timerPolicy.completionExpectation: Do not require every participant to consume the full 20 minutes; timeout remains server-authoritative.

reservePolicy.purpose: Operational reserve for future content rotation, retirement, review findings, and package resilience; reserve items are not runtime-eligible until separately approved/published.
reservePolicy.psychometricClaim: This is an operational content-governance policy, not a psychometric sufficiency standard.

RIASEC.intendedUse: interest exploration and relative RIASEC profile
scoringNotes: Six dimensions are scored as relative interest dimensions.
Top code is descriptive and must not be presented as a universal score.
Production 60-item scoring remains the existing RIASEC V2 contract.

DISC.intendedUse: descriptive behavioral profile for self-understanding and development
DISC.currentEngineConstraint: Current DISC V2 scoring engine requires exactly 24 questions. V13.4 does not change the scoring engine.
scoringNotes: Each item must retain item-specific four-option scoringKey mapping to D/I/S/C.
Target composition is content/taxonomy coverage; it must not be interpreted as four independently scored item pools unless the scoring model explicitly supports that interpretation.
80-item scoring semantics, normalization, missing-response behavior, and result compatibility must be resolved in V13.7 before publication.

EQ.intendedUse: self-exploration of relative response patterns across four EQ dimensions
EQ.currentEngineConstraint: Current EQ V2 scoring engine requires exactly 24 questions. V13.4 does not change the scoring engine.
scoringNotes: Each item uses SINGLE_CHOICE_4 with an explicit item-specific four-value scoring key.
Dimension scores use keyed ordinal scoring normalized to 0-100 under the existing V2 model.
The 50-item composition is a production design target and must be validated for score semantics and result interpretation in V13.7.

COGNITIVE.intendedUse: descriptive reasoning performance profile; not a clinical IQ test
COGNITIVE.currentEngineConstraint: Current Cognitive V2 scoring engine requires exactly 24 questions and six questions per dimension. V13.4 does not change the scoring engine.
scoringNotes: Each item uses SINGLE_CHOICE_4 and one correct option.
Difficulty distribution must be defined and validated during production content work without changing the objective scoring contract implicitly.
40-item scoring, dimension normalization, timeout behavior, and result compatibility must be resolved in V13.7 before publication.

crossAssessmentRules: No assessment may be published merely because its package reaches the target item count.
Blueprint composition must equal totalItems exactly.
All referenced taxonomy nodes must belong to the assessment's V2 taxonomy.
Production pool minimum is target plus the operational reserve minimum.
Reserve questions are not runtime-eligible until they pass the same review, mapping, approval, and publication controls.
Scoring version is an explicit blueprint dependency and may not be silently changed by package configuration.
The 20-minute timer is a maximum allowed time and remains server-authoritative.
No blueprint grants clinical, diagnostic, universal-score, IQ, or guaranteed-career claims where prohibited by the existing instrument contracts.
Legacy general-readiness questions are outside these production instrument pools unless explicitly authorized by a later specification.

phaseDependencies.V13.5: Build production candidate pools to these quantities and composition targets.
phaseDependencies.V13.6: Approve taxonomy mappings and content against this blueprint.
phaseDependencies.V13.7: Validate scoring compatibility, especially the non-24-item DISC/EQ/Cognitive targets.
phaseDependencies.V13.8: Translate the frozen composition and timer into Question Package configuration.
phaseDependencies.V13.9: Establish production eligibility and package publication boundary.
